refrigerant.confirm.tip1: Used for refrigerant diagnosis in V8 VRF systems, automatically refilling refrigerant in cases of low refrigerant levels.
refrigerant.confirm.tip2: 1. Diagnosis and refilling are only supported by V8 protocol; V8V6 protocol only supports viewing parameters
refrigerant.tipbox.title: Refrigerant judgment tips
refrigerant.tipbox.content:
1. Cooling:
Check the subcooling degree of the ODU heat exchanger TC-TL, ＜3°C indicates low refrigerant, 3~10°C indicates normal refrigerant levels, ＞10°C indicates excess refrigerant.
2. Heating:
Check the subcooling degree of the indoor heat exchanger TC-T2A average, ＜5°C indicates insufficient refrigerant, 5-10°C indicates normal refrigerant, ＞10°C indicates excess refrigerant.
refrigerant.tipbox.content1:
V8/V6 Protocol - Cooling:
20°C≤T4≤43°C
10°C<TC-T4<15°
All of the above conditions must be met before judging the refrigerant condition based on the minimum subcooling degree Min
(TC-TL):
Subcooling degree<3°C indicates insufficient refrigerant
3°C≤Subcooling degree≤10°C indicates normal refrigerant
Subcooling degree>10°C indicates excess refrigerant

V8 Protocol - Heating:
Check the subcooling degree of the indoor heat exchanger TC min-T2A average:
Subcooling degree<5°C indicates insufficient refrigerant,
5°C≤Subcooling degree≤10°C indicates normal refrigerant
Subcooling degree>10°C indicates excess refrigerant

V6 Protocol - Heating:
Check the subcooling degree of the indoor heat exchanger Min(TC-T5):
Subcooling degree<10°C indicates insufficient refrigerant,
10°C≤Subcooling degree≤15°C indicates normal refrigerant
Subcooling degree>15°C indicates excess refrigerant

electronicexpansionvalve.main:
After the diagnosis is complete, please power off the IDU and reinsert the electronic expansion valve into the indoor unit's motherboard. Power it back on, and the electronic expansion valve will reset automatically.
Failure to follow these steps may result in damage to the outdoor unit's compressor!

moadd.step1.title: Retrofit Cloud Module
moadd.step2.tip:
Simple spray: For outdoor units (including competitors), a spray device must be installed, along with a spray sensor (T4/Compressor exhaust temperature). If the ODU is V4+ or V5, the cloud control function can be achieved.
Retrofit analysis: For V4+ or V5 outdoor units, a retrofit analysis sensor (high pressure, low pressure, liquid pipe temperature, and compressor return gas temperature) must be installed to achieve cloud control and energy consumption analysis functions.
Smart spray: For V4+V5 outdoor units, a spray device must be installed, along with spray sensors (high pressure, low pressure, liquid pipe temperature, and compressor return gas temperature) to achieve cloud spray, cloud control, and energy consumption analysis functions.
